---
title: "Input Data"
---

Both packages consume the same four kinds of input. This section documents
each one's expected schema, with examples drawn from the
[demo dataset](../demo-data/index.qmd).

| Input | Format | Pages |
|---|---|---|
| SNP genotypes | VCF or dosage matrix (CSV) | [SNP](snp.qmd) |
| Microhaplotype calls | tab-delimited per locus | [Microhaplotypes](microhaplotypes.qmd) |
| Phenotypes | CSV: id, fixed effects, response(s) | [Phenotype](phenotype.qmd) |
| Pedigree | CSV: id, sire, dam | [Pedigree](pedigree.qmd) |
